data.title: 贞德[Alter] · 王座厅沉思
data.description: 【贞德[Alter] · 王座厅沉思】空旷昏暗的王座厅内唯有两旁的火把在无声燃烧，黑贞孤身坐在高高台阶的扶手旁，指尖无聊地敲击着剑柄。察觉到你的脚步声，她眼底的戾气悄然散去——「这么晚了还不去睡觉……算了，反正我也睡不着。过来坐下，陪我说会儿话。」
data.action: 坐在宽阔王座扶手上，一手稳住横在腿上的带鞘剑，另一手指尖轻叩剑柄
data.lighting: warm torchlight along the otherwise dark hall
data.promptProse: Jeanne Alter sits on the iron throne's broad armrest with a boot supported on its step, steadying a sheathed sword across armored knees while her other fingers tap the pommel. Her golden eyes lift at the viewer's approach. In the medium view, the dragon banner remains in a floor holder by the far wall. Warm torchlight outlines her silver hair, black armor and throne edges, with the empty hall receding into darkness.
